vfairness.operations.pulse.regulatory.bu.grade_note: Key corrected 2026-09-27: it was recorded as vfairness.operations.pulse.build_art10, which does not resolve. build_art10 lives in vfairness.operations.pulse.regulatory, like every sibling graded in the same batch. The grade and its evidence are unchanged; only the address was wrong.

method: Each item was executed on healthy input carrying a real findable disparity and on the degenerate inputs where the thing it claims to measure does not exist, then graded into one of five states. Every claim that could hide a defect was re-checked by an independent agent told to refute it; where the auditor overturned the grade, the AUDITOR'S grade is recorded here, not the grader's. An item with audited=false carries a claim, not a measurement.

states.DEFECT OPEN: proved by execution to report a value nobody measured
states.NOT A MEASUREMENT: produces no fairness number and no verdict, so the defect class cannot apply; assigned only after running it
states.PROVEN: refuses honestly when nothing is measurable, measures correctly when something is, and a test holds it there
states.SEMI-PROVEN: behaves honestly today, verified by execution, but no pin fails when it regresses

vfairness.operations.monitoring.tracker..grade_note: for the only callable of that name, TemporalFairnessAnalyzer.get_metric_summary). The row as written must not stand as NOT A MEASUREMENT: FairnessMonitor.get_metric_summary does not exist, and the callable that does exist is a measurement. The grading agent's own flag was correct.
vfairness.operations.monitoring.tracker..retired: Retired 2026-09-27: FairnessMonitor has no get_metric_summary and never did, so this row graded nothing. The audit that overturned it to PROVEN said exactly that in its own note and recorded the grade anyway, and it has been counted in the published PROVEN total ever since. The real callable of that name, vfairness.operations.monitoring.tracker.TemporalFairnessAnalyzer.get_metric_summary, carries its own row and was re-graded PROVEN by the 2026-09-25 wave. Kept here rather than deleted so the count can be reconciled against earlier publications.
